mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 75 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. If you are heading out tonight, look to the West over Mount Horeb starting at 7:36 PM to see the International Space Station as it travels toward the Northeast near the Home Depot for a five minute show.

The Verona Police Department has released a summary of calls from August 31 to September 14. This report includes a variety of incidents, ranging from a domestic battery case on North Main Street to an arrest for a serious burglary on Hunters Cove Way.

Your local calendar is packed. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returns to Hometown Junction Park, and you can also catch trivia at The Bogey Factory or enjoy pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a noteworthy incident from the past two weeks, on September 5, an officer responded to a viral prank where vehicles were found with slices of cheese left on their windshields, though thankfully, no damage was reported.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel. We look forward to their reopening and will keep you posted on when you can grab your next flavor of the day.
